Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance:

Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: at consignee destination 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sr. DFM/NR/MB . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. (i) Only Manufacturers or their authorized dealers distributors (except for Q1 & Q2 category) need to qu ote with bid specific authorization from the manufacturers failing which offer will be summarily rejected. (ii). In case bidders participate as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be th at of the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply for a different Principal but this will not be considered as performance for placing bulk order in case of change of Principal. 2. (i) The Bidder should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 20% (i.e. at least 02 nos. for t his item) of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization/PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts (proving suppl y of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quant ity supplied in the relevant financial year. The similar product category will be the bid item having same de scription, but of different sizes/ratings/capacities The bidder is required to submit proof of successful suppl y. Purchase order alone shall not be considered as work experience. In case of any documents submitted b y bidders are found to be forged or fake, the concerned bidder shall be debarred for future purchases and the action of suspension from the GeM shall also be initiated. ii) The onus of submission of requisite documents such as copies CRAC, CRN, Receipt note shall be respons ibility of the bidder. (iii) No fresh documents will be accepted after bid opening also not be accepted in representation. 3. Bidders to must submit Following Test reports from NABL/ILAC accredited lab at the time of bidding failing which offer will be summarily rejected:- a) Type Tests report as per IEC 60068, b) EMI/EMC Test rep ort as per IEC 61326-1., c) Electrical Safety Tests as per IEC 61010-1 and IEC 61010-031. 4. Bidders to submit the point-wise compliance to above Annexure-A at the time of bidding, otherwise thei r offer will be summarily rejected. 5. Bidders to upload the catalogue/datasheet of make /model which depicts the technical parameters and f eatures of offered product at the time of bidding, failing which offer will be summarily rejected. 6. Material to be supplied along with calibration certificate from NABL accredited lab which will be valid for one year. 7. The material is to be supplied along with operating manual, warranty certificate and requisite accessories. Demonstration and training for operating the device, wherever required, shall be provided by the seller at his own cost and responsibility.

8. The material should be supplied as per the enclosed annexure. 9. The material will be delivered at the Haridwar Station. . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
